title: Nine Shillings and One Swan
subtitle: 舞蹈韵律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 舞蹈韵律（文学艺术与体育·舞蹈与韵律）
meta: 主题语境：舞蹈韵律（文学艺术与体育·舞蹈与韵律）　|　核心词汇：ballet　|　正文 315 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ballet 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 my aunt paid nine shillings to see ① a ballet she could not pronounce, and she said the ticket was the cheap part. The ② ballet, meaning the evening and not the dancing, lasted two hours and was discussed for eleven; a ballet, she said, is the only thing that costs more to talk about than to see.

Every ③ ballet in that city began at a quarter past, and the ④ ballet on the Thursday, meaning the one with the white swans and not either of those, was the only one she ever saw twice. A ballet, my mother said, is nine parts training and one part pretending it is easy; my aunt said the pretending is the whole of the art.

My grandfather meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ ballet was the whole of patience, meaning the years in the room and not the evening. The ⑥ ballet, meaning the practice and not any of that, happened at six in the morning for eleven years; a ballet, he said, is either a night out or the only job where the rehearsal is the work. He said the performance is the receipt.

By 1969 the ⑦ ballet had become a photograph in a newspaper, and the photograph had become an argument about the shoes. The ⑧ ballet of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in May, was nine years of mornings and one review; a ballet, she said, is either the evening you remember or the mornings nobody saw. She said the mornings were the better half.

The ⑨ ballet I remember is the one with the white swans, which she described for thirty years and never saw again. A ⑩ ballet, my mother said in 1972, is the only art that is finished before it is judged; every ballet, she said, is a rehearsal that has agreed to look like an occasion. She said the occasion is the alibi.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 芭蕾舞（演出、剧目）
B. n. 芭蕾舞（指那个夜晚的演出，与舞蹈本身相对）
C. 固定搭配：see a ballet 看一场芭蕾舞
D. n. 芭蕾舞（指城里每一场）
E. n. 芭蕾舞（指星期四那一场）
F. n. 芭蕾舞（指耐心，即年复一年的练习）
G. n. 芭蕾舞（抽象：训练这件事）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a ballet she could not pronounce
The ballet, meaning the evening and not the dancing
ballet was the whole of patience
the ballet had become a photograph in a newspaper
The ballet of the whole thing
A ballet, my mother said in 1972

answers.why: see a ballet 意为“看一场芭蕾舞”，1957 年姑姑花九先令去看一场她念不出名字的芭蕾舞。
ballet 意为“芭蕾舞演出”，指那个夜晚的演出而不是舞蹈本身，演了两小时却被讨论了十一年。
ballet 指城里每一场芭蕾舞，那座城市里每一场都是一刻过开始。
ballet 指星期四那一场（有白天鹅的那一场），是她唯一看过两次的。
ballet 意为“芭蕾舞”，指耐心，即在练功房里年复一年的练习，而不是那个夜晚。
ballet 为抽象用法，指训练这件事，它十一年里每天早上六点发生。
ballet 意为“芭蕾舞（剧目、演出）”，到 1969 年这个 ballet 成了报纸上的一张照片。
ballet 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，姑姑五月写道，整件事权衡下来是九年的清晨和一篇评论。
ballet 意为“芭蕾舞（剧目）”，我记得的是有白天鹅的那一场，她讲了三十年，却再没看过。
ballet 为抽象总称，母亲说芭蕾舞是唯一在被评判之前就已经完成的艺术。
